description: This file defines the AlarmRepository interface for accessing and manipulating alarm data in a SQL database, including custom queries for alarms, filtering, and alarm management operations.

classes.name: AlarmRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for AlarmEntity with custom query methods for alarm operations.

methods.name: findLatestByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds latest alarms by originator ID and type, ordered descending by start timestamp.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds latest active (not cleared) alarms by originator ID and type.

methods.name: findAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves paged alarms filtered by tenant, entity, time range, and various filters.

methods.name: findAlarmsV2
methods.description: Enhanced version of findAlarms with additional filters for alarm types and severities.

methods.name: findAllAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves all alarms with basic filters, no specific entity or customer filtering.

methods.name: findAllAlarmsV2
methods.description: Enhanced version of findAllAlarms with additional filters for alarm types and severities.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves alarms filtered by tenant and customer IDs with filters.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarmsV2
methods.description: Enhanced version of findCustomerAlarms with additional filters.

methods.name: findAlarmSeverities
methods.description: Retrieves set of alarm severities for a specific entity and filters.

methods.name: findAlarmsIdsByEndTsBeforeAndTenantId
methods.description: Finds alarm IDs with end timestamp before a specified time for a tenant.

methods.name: findAlarmInfoById
methods.description: Fetches detailed alarm info by tenant and alarm ID.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByAssigneeId
methods.description: Retrieves paged alarm IDs assigned to a specific user.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByAssigneeId (with offsets)
methods.description: Retrieves paged alarm IDs assigned to a user with offset filtering.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByOriginatorId (with offsets)
methods.description: Retrieves paged alarm IDs by originator ID with offset filtering.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByOriginatorId (without offsets)
methods.description: Retrieves paged alarm IDs by originator ID.

methods.name: createOrUpdateActiveAlarm
methods.description: Calls native SQL function to create or update an active alarm.

methods.name: updateAlarm
methods.description: Calls native SQL function to update an existing alarm.

methods.name: acknowledgeAlarm
methods.description: Calls native SQL function to acknowledge an alarm.

methods.name: clearAlarm
methods.description: Calls native SQL function to clear an alarm.

methods.name: assignAlarm
methods.description: Calls native SQL function to assign an alarm to a user.

methods.name: unassignAlarm
methods.description: Calls native SQL function to unassign an alarm.

methods.name: findTenantAlarmTypes
methods.description: Retrieves paged list of alarm types for a tenant matching search text.

methods.name: deleteTypeIfNoAlarmsExist
methods.description: Deletes alarm types if no alarms of that type exist for the tenant.

methods.name: findActiveOriginatorAlarms
methods.description: Finds active alarms for a specific originator with filters, limited by count.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds alarms by tenant ID with pagination.
